turns.text: We'll explore how to make your conversations more natural and engaging.
turns.zh: 我们会聊聊怎么让你的对话更自然、更有意思。

turns.text: We'll share some fantastic tips to help you sound more fluent and confident when chatting with native speakers or other English learners.
turns.zh: 我们会分享一些超棒的技巧，帮你在跟母语者或其他英语学习者聊天时，听起来更流利、更自信。

turns.text: Plus, we've got some real life examples and common situations you might face.
turns.zh: 另外，我们还准备了一些真实生活中的例子和你可能遇到的常见场景。

turns.text: Whether you're at work, traveling, or just making new friends,
turns.zh: 不管你是在工作、旅行，还是刚交新朋友，

turns.text: So, grab your headphones, get comfortable, and let's start this amazing journey together.
turns.zh: 所以，戴上耳机，找个舒服的姿势，咱们一起开始这段精彩的旅程吧。

turns.text: Before we begin, remember making mistakes is totally normal and actually helps you learn faster.
turns.zh: 开始之前，记住犯错完全正常，而且其实能帮你学得更快。
